In the Data For Good generative AI white paper, BLOOM's estimated training carbon footprint initially was calculated at 30 tonnes CO2eq. When extending the scope to include additional factors such as the consumption of other data center equipment (increasing energy consumption from 433 MWh to 690 MWh), excluding PUE, the impact rose to 39.3 tonnes CO2eq. Including the environmental impact of manufacturing servers and GPUs increased the estimate further to 50.5 tonnes CO2eq. Finally, when adding the phase of model development (tests, evaluations, corrections), which was estimated to add 73.32 tonnes CO2eq, the total full-scope carbon footprint estimate for BLOOM's training reached 123.82 tonnes CO2eq. 

Thus, the estimate increased from an initial 30 tonnes CO2eq to a full-scope estimate of 123.82 tonnes CO2eq, about four times higher than the initial calculation.
